'''Kellov''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] terrorist group [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] who was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] during the [[Skirmish on Carlac]].

Kellov used a stolen [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] as his primary weapon of choice. He red and gray set of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]].
